Very well done.|[[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Mack Jasper]], to a CorSec recruit|<ref name="SWG:HFPH">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Help Farmer Pol Handerin|Corellia}}</ref>}}
'''One CorSec Plaza''', also known as the '''CorSec Headquarters''', was a building located within [[CorSec Plaza/Legends|CorSec Plaza]] in [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City]] on the [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. It was the headquarters of the [[Corellian Security Force]].<ref name="IJ" />

==History==
{{Quote|I could have marched Bossk into One CorSec Plaza, right there in the lobby, and blown his head off in front of hundreds of witnesses, and they'd have all said the prisoner was escaping and a threat to others.|[[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran Horn]], to [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]|<ref name="IJ" />}}
In [[3640 BBY]], the CorSec Headquarters was attacked by a [[Hunter (individual)|bounty hunter]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Battle of Corellia]] of the [[Galactic War]]. The [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] captured [[Commissioner/Legends|CorSec Commissioner]] [[Jonah Carter]].<ref name="TOR" />

Ex-CorSec agent [[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran Horn]], during his [[Jedi training/Legends|training]] at the [[Jedi Praxeum]] on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]], once told [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] that he could have marched [[Bossk/Legends|Bossk]], the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] who had killed his [[Hal Horn|father]] into One CorSec Plaza, pull out a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]], shoot him in the head in front of hundreds of witnesses, and that everyone present would have sworn that the [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] was "resisting arrest" and was a danger to those around him.<ref name="IJ" />
